prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Impeccable visual direction card, landscape 16:9
Primary request: Create exactly one flat matte unfinished UI design sketch for a desktop React web app used repeatedly by quantity surveyors to review hundreds of beam and column records extracted from construction PDFs, resolve AI ambiguities using linked drawing evidence, edit records, and export validated data. Visual world: a creator-hardware desk instrument translated into an efficient expert interface.
Scene/backdrop: Full-frame interface direction card, no surrounding room, no device mockup, no photorealistic keyboard.
Subject: A restrained desktop workspace where the construction drawing evidence is the dominant large working area. Around it, arrange a tight modular key-unit grid of discrete shortcut-like tools, compact beam/column record rows, ambiguity states, and evidence-linked controls. Include one unmistakable safety-orange commit action and a narrow amber live-status strip. The overall structure should feel like an exacting studio controller or editing console without resembling a literal keyboard.
Style/medium: Flat matte high-fidelity concept sketch with intentionally unfinished design-study character; crisp vector-like shapes, subtle pencil/marker construction notes, tactile detent/state feedback expressed through inset borders, pressed states, tiny indicator notches, and physical-control proportions. No gloss, no photorealism, no 3D product render.
Composition/framing: Landscape 16:9. Same framing as a professional UI direction card: straight-on orthographic view, dense but calm expert workspace, drawing evidence clearly larger than supporting controls. Avoid equal three-panel layout and generic dashboard composition. Keep strong hierarchy and efficient scan paths.
Color palette: Bone and putty control grays over gunmetal; charcoal legends and rules; exactly one safety-orange primary commit control; narrow amber live-status strip. Restrained, low-saturation, utilitarian.
Materials/textures: Powder-coated metal, matte polymer keycaps, paper drawing texture used sparingly inside the evidence canvas.
Text (verbatim): "Structural Drawing Assistant"
Constraints: The only legible text anywhere must be “Structural Drawing Assistant”. Render every other label, table entry, annotation, number, and drawing note as indistinct greeking, abstract bars, or illegible micro-marks. No factual claims. Make the title clearly legible once. Prioritize a simple, expert production workflow over complexity.
Avoid: literal keyboard photo, laptop or monitor mockup, generic SaaS dashboard, equal three panels, excessive UI complexity, chat-first AI motifs, glassmorphism, gradients, neon, glossy surfaces, photorealism, readable secondary text, logos, watermarks.
